_comment: Timing/memory measurement only for HuBERT-CTC: same model, data and optimizer settings as hubert_ctc.json with a fixed small budget of 50 updates and one dev evaluation at the end. Read seconds_per_update_excluding_dev, dev_eval_seconds and peak GPU memory from run.json to choose max_steps for hubert_ctc.json. Its checkpoint is not a baseline result.
